integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic. A lighthouse keeper's kitchen at the edge of the world. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed. Beyond the windows, a glittering sun shower over a black sea. An axolotl in a knitted scarf pours tea for two. The keeper with a warm, raspy old voice (S1) says: <d>[English] The ships stopped coming years ago.</d> [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a close-up of the second teacup, steam curling up, the chair across the table still empty. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot transitions with a cross-dissolve to the empty chair, now holding a translucent woman made of sea spray who smiles at the axolotl. The camera arcs around the subject at slow speed. The ghost with a soft, echoing voice (S2) says: <d>[French] Je suis toujours venue.</d> The keeper (S1) says: <d>[English] I know.</d>

overall_soundscape: A kettle hisses and wind worries the shutters. A clock ticks. Waves swell far below and a single gull cries.

non_diegetic_music: A music box melody at a slow tempo, joined by sustained low strings that rise and then fade.
